title: Overview
summary: Company page stating that United Exports was established in 2002 by Roger Horak as a vertically integrated fruit exporter, moving from low-chill stone fruit into evergreen blueberries.
why_it_matters: Baseline corporate facts for the third organisation in this wave, and context for why an exporter rather than a breeder ended up controlling a major variety platform.

reading.rationale: Baseline facts required before any assessment.

commercial_position.rationale: Vertical integration from farm to export is a distinct competitive model.
